description: Baseline harness crashed: subprocess stdout includes scenario output (e.g., help/plain text), so JSON parsing of entire stdout failed. Switched parser to read last non-empty line as JSON payload.
Fixed first_help scenario to pass required run_cli(fetch=...) argument after baseline failed with TypeError for missing positional fetch.

Established import-surface baseline harness with fresh-process scenarios (core/root/first-use) and secondary module+allocation metrics. Benchmark runs cleanly; correctness gate currently fails on pre-existing formatting issue in src/painted/search.py.
